items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Harry I know used to play on the boats... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Harry Diles. He played with Fate? I believe. Or Dewey Jackson.

ctx.x: I just wondered if there were any Kim, because Harry I know used to play on the boats. Where was he from? I think he was from around St. Louis, but he played on the boats too.
Yeah, Harry Diles. He played with Fate? I believe. Or Dewey Jackson.
I forget, I can't remember all that.
